Antique Reclaimed Wood – 9 Ft Long – 6 Pieces
$200 - 81521

Beautiful antique reclaimed wood with tons of original character and patina. These boards have an aged finish with a mix of warm brown, amber, cream, and dark tones, along with naturally distressed/chippy areas that give them a true one-of-a-kind look.

6 matching/ coordinating pieces. Each piece measures approximately 108” long × 5 3/8” wide × 3/4” thick. The wood has attractive old-growth-style grain and appears to retain much of its original aged finish. Great pieces for someone looking for authentic reclaimed material rather than newly distressed lumber.

Perfect for mantels, faux ceiling beams, shelving, rustic trim, accent walls, farmhouse projects, furniture, door/window trim, or architectural salvage projects.

These are genuinely aged pieces and show wear, scratches, finish loss, discoloration, and other imperfections consistent with antique/reclaimed wood. Selling all 6 together.

Dimensions: 108” long each, Width 5 3/8”, Thickness 3/4”
